title: BRAKES HOT

actions.say: If on the ground, delay the take-off and allow the brakes to cool.
Leave the landing gear extended after take-off to aid cooling, gear up not before the appropriate time.
Monitor the brake temperatures on the wheel page and avoid parking with the parking brake if very hot.

status: Status. Brake temperatures high; observe the maximum brake temperature for take-off.
Expect an extended gear period after take-off for cooling.
If a tyre or brake fire is suspected on the ground, apply the appropriate procedure and consider evacuation.
